clips.title: The story
paras: In the Pools of Vision, Miles Welsh teaches priests beneath Thunder Bluff. The Forsaken trainer offers spiritual instruction and shadow discipline in the tauren capital.

Miles Welsh teaches priests in the Pools of Vision beneath Thunder Bluff. Far from Lordaeron's plague-scarred ruins, the Forsaken priest makes his home in the grotto beneath the city. He instructs travelers in divine and shadowy energies. His place in the heart of Mulgore reflects the tenuous ties between the Forsaken and the Horde. There, he shares sanctuary with tauren mystics and shamans while guiding acolytes in shadow and faith.
